annotation.reasoning_summary: The dataset represents individual housing blocks or building clusters owned by housing associations, which are discrete, identifiable real-world objects. While numeric attributes are provided, the polygons fundamentally represent the spatial extent of these physical housing assets, not reporting zones or full-area coverage.

The dataset represents specific archaeological points (cesspits and findings) at discrete locations. These are clearly identifiable real-world assets/objects rather than measurements, events, or amounts.

The dataset maps individual archaeological finds located in waterbeds. Each point represents a distinct, countable real-world object with unique attributes (Objectcode, Bijschrift), falling clearly under ObjectDS.
